focused_windows_host_test.result: PASS on Windows after bounded request-body rejection fix

fix.cause: The handler rejected an invalid bearer token before consuming the request body, then closed the socket with unread bytes. Windows could reset the connection before the client received the intended 403 response.
fix.correction: Use reject_request to parse only one bounded Content-Length, send the rejection, and drain at most MAX_BODY+1 bytes without parsing or dispatch. Track body_consumed so post-dispatch denials do not attempt to drain an already consumed body.
